question: At which of the following jails was Khudiram Bose sent to the gallows?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Muzaffarpur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Shahid Khudiram Bose** was the** youngest revolutionary freedom fighter who opposed British Raj in India**.
 
• He was born on ** 3 December 1889, in the Midnapore district of West Bengal**.
 
• Khudiram Bose was sent to Muzaffarpur Jail under the charge of conspiracy to kill
